question.text: Under Regulation 7I of SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015, 'employee' for purposes of informant protection does NOT include:

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 7I defines 'employee' as a director, partner, regular or contractual employee, and explicitly excludes an advocate. The Trap: Advocates may have access to UPSI through their work, but they are specifically excluded from this employee definition for informant protection purposes. Note: The source-backed definition itself is what matters here; the reason for excluding advocates is not specified by the workbook page checked.
